comment: Declarations for the triage example: the actions a help desk binds to meanings, declared once each — a name, the desk tool's command, a plain description, the argument slots it takes, and a few example lines. The interpreter (interpret package) matches what a person types against these descriptions at runtime; nothing is trained per action. See FORMATS.md at the repo root for the file format.

scripts.description: pages the on-call engineer about an urgent outage
examples: get the on-call engineer on this
scripts.name: page-oncall

scripts.description: routes a ticket to the billing team queue
examples: give this one to the billing team
scripts.name: route-to-billing

scripts.description: routes a ticket to the technical support queue
examples: send this to the technical team
this one is for the engineers
the technical queue should take it
scripts.name: route-to-technical

scripts.description: sends the customer the password reset guide
examples: send the customer the reset guide
scripts.name: send-password-guide

scripts.description: forwards a ticket from the support inbox to the vendor queue
examples: forward this from support to the vendor
pass it from the inbox to the vendor queue
scripts.name: forward-to-vendor

scripts.description: creates a follow-up task for the team
examples: create a follow-up called check the backup
open a task titled verify the refund
scripts.name: create-followup
